{{Top|leg}}
The '''Beetle-knights''' were an ancient order of warriors that guarded [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] in its pre-industrial age. Their armor inspired the armor worn by the warriors of the [[Neimoidian Gunnery Battalion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
